source.title: Two open problems in vector optimization

trace.notes: Input normalized as a zbMATH landing URL with identifier 22368. Direct fetch of https://zbmath.org/22368 returned HTTP 403 with a Cloudflare challenge, so the landing page was classified as blocked_or_challenged.

Identifier-specific recovery through the zbMATH Open REST API found the exact record: R. Nehse, original title 'Zwei offene Probleme in der Vektoroptimierung.', translated title 'Two open problems in vector optimization', Wissenschaftliche Zeitschrift der Technischen Hochschule Ilmenau 37, No. 3, pages 45-53, 1991, zbMATH identifier 0760.90081. The API record exposed no full-text links and was used only as resolver metadata.

Bounded exact-work recovery searched for the exact German title, the English title with Nehse, the journal citation with volume/issue/pages, and ISSN 0043-6917. Candidate pages inspected or rejected included zbMATH serial metadata, CiNii and ZDB serial holdings, TU Ilmenau publication listings, OUCI reference-list pages, and a separate book page for Theory of Vector Optimization. These were metadata, holdings, reference lists, or different works, not a readable exact-work copy of the article.

No readable PDF or full HTML artifact for the exact article was recovered within the bounded pass. Extraction from zbMATH metadata, abstracts, snippets, serial holdings, and related works is disallowed by the source-adequacy gate.
Saved final JSON to outputs/parse-paper/22368.json and outputs/latest.json.
